title: Refund policy
text: StashBox offers a full refund within 30 days of purchase on any paid plan. After 30 days, refunds are not available, but you can cancel to stop future charges. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Cancel a subscription
text: To cancel, go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period. Your files remain accessible in read-only mode for 60 days after cancellation, then they are permanently deleted.

title: Plans and pricing
text: StashBox has three plans. Free: 5 GB storage, 1 user. Pro: 2 TB storage, 1 user, 12 USD per month. Team: 5 TB storage per user, minimum 3 users, 20 USD per user per month. Annual billing gives a 20 percent discount.

title: Storage limits and upgrades
text: When you reach your storage limit, new uploads are blocked but existing files stay available. You can upgrade at any time from Settings > Plan. Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated for the current billing period.

title: Reset your password
text: Click Forgot password on the login page and enter your email. We send a reset link that expires in 30 minutes. If you do not receive it, check spam and make sure you used the email address on your account.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: Enable two-factor authentication in Settings > Security. You can use an authenticator app or SMS codes. Save the 10 backup codes shown during setup. If you lose your device, use a backup code to sign in, then reconfigure 2FA.

title: Share files with a link
text: Right-click a file, choose Share, then Create link. You can set the link to view-only or edit, add a password, and set an expiry date. Anyone with the link can access the file until it expires or you disable the link.

title: Folder permissions for teams
text: Team admins can share folders with specific members as Viewer, Editor or Owner. Viewers can download, Editors can upload and rename, and Owners can manage permissions and delete. Permissions inherit down to subfolders unless overridden.

title: Maximum file size
text: The maximum single file size is 5 GB on the Free plan, 50 GB on Pro and 100 GB on Team. Uploads larger than 2 GB must use the desktop app, because browser uploads are limited to 2 GB.

title: Troubleshooting sync problems
text: If files are not syncing, first check that the desktop app is signed in and not paused. Then verify you have free disk space and internet access. Restart the app, and if the problem persists, use Help > Reset sync, which re-scans your folder without deleting files.

title: Recover deleted files
text: Deleted files go to Trash and stay there for 30 days on Free and Pro, and 90 days on Team. To restore, open Trash, select the files and click Restore. After the retention period files are permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.

title: Version history
text: StashBox keeps previous versions of edited files for 30 days on Free, 180 days on Pro and 365 days on Team. Open a file, choose Version history and click Restore on the version you want. Restoring creates a new version rather than overwriting.

title: Encryption and security
text: Files are encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. StashBox holds the encryption keys by default. Team plans can enable customer-managed keys so only your organization can decrypt data.

title: Compliance certifications
text: StashBox is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified. Team plans can sign a data processing agreement for GDPR. We do not currently offer HIPAA business associate agreements.

title: Data residency
text: Team plan customers can choose to store data in the US, EU or India regions. The region is chosen when the workspace is created and cannot be changed afterwards. Free and Pro accounts are stored in the US region.

title: Desktop app requirements
text: The desktop app runs on Windows 10 or later, macOS 12 or later, and Ubuntu 20.04 or later. It needs at least 4 GB of RAM and 500 MB of free disk space. There is also an iOS and Android mobile app.

title: Offline access
text: Mark files or folders as Available offline in the desktop or mobile app. They are downloaded and kept in sync when you reconnect. Offline files count against your local disk space, not your StashBox storage.

title: API access
text: The StashBox REST API is available on Pro and Team plans. Create an API token in Settings > Developer. The default rate limit is 100 requests per minute, and Team plans can request an increase through support.

title: Invoices and receipts
text: Download invoices from Settings > Billing > Invoices. Team admins can add a company name and tax ID that will appear on future invoices. Past invoices cannot be edited, but we can reissue one through support.

title: Accepted payment methods
text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express and UPI for Indian customers. Team plans on annual billing can pay by bank transfer. Prepaid cards are not supported.

title: Add and remove team members
text: Admins invite members from Admin console > Users by entering email addresses. Removing a member revokes access immediately, and their files can be transferred to another user within 30 days before they are deleted.

title: Single sign-on
text: SAML single sign-on is available on the Team plan. Admins configure it in Admin console > Security with an identity provider such as Okta or Azure AD. SCIM user provisioning is also supported.

title: Contacting support
text: Free users get help through the community forum. Pro users get email support with a response within 24 hours. Team users get priority email and chat support with a response within 4 hours on business days.

title: Delete your account
text: Go to Settings > Account > Delete account. This permanently deletes all your files, shared links and version history after a 14-day grace period during which you can log in to cancel the deletion. Cancel any paid plan first to stop billing.
